conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I got a letter saying my loan’s overdue, but I paid it! What’s happening?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the confusion, ma’am. Can you share your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s two three four, five six seven, eight nine zero. I don’t understand why I got this letter.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It seems the payment wasn’t reflected due to a system error. I’ll update it now.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Please do. I don’t want any trouble.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s updated Sir. You’re all clear, and I’ll send a confirmation.
